verdict.rationale: Missive documents rule-based workflow automation (up to 1000 rules) that runs in the background, plus an AI Assistant/agent feature whose 'sessions' run autonomously enough that 'long assistant sessions no longer need babysitting,' with a session tab to monitor progress and MCP-enabled agents that can triage conversations before a human looks at them. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of long-running unattended reliability and richer documentation of automation trigger/action configuration beyond marketing copy.
